notes: await sharp(bytes).ensureAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true }), default options. sharp.cache(false) and sharp.concurrency(1) are called once at load, so libvips neither answers a repeated decode from its operation cache nor works on more than one thread. The work runs on libuv pool threads while the JavaScript thread waits; CPU counts every thread. A native add-on (libvips behind N-API), installed as a prebuilt binary.
